task: N2.11 bounded compiler frontend feasibility for exact configured Linux consumer
purpose: Stop extending synthetic syntax as a substitute for Linux. Test whether existing target GCC can preserve actual configured GNU C consumer control/read/write and source coordinates in compiler output; no automatic contract or def-use proof claimed.
registration: Before commands/output execution; N2.10 method/oracle/results remain frozen and failures unchanged. Existing known Linux source only, no holdout.

scope.primary: old_s390 exact full core.i, then old_x86 only if primary frontend succeeds; same known revision. Preserve original i/config/build/source bytes.
scope.command: Read saved .core.o.cmd, shlex tokenize without shell; require expected compiler basename and one known original core.c input. Replace only input with exact prior core.i and compiler path with known installed target compiler; switch -c to -S, absolute -o under this stage raw/profile, remove dependency-generation flags (-Wp,-MMD,... and any output-writing dependency options). Keep other original target/semantic/optimization flags; add -x cpp-output and explicit absolute original/gimple dump paths including line info. Record every argument addition/removal/replacement. No preprocessing, source rewriting, stubs, hand C projection, flags chosen after failure, or old build mutation.
scope.outputs: New assembly plus GCC original/gimple dumps only in ignored raw/ under new Windows stage; complete stdout/stderr/argv/elapsed/status. No assembler/linker/full kernel build or boot. At most one compiler invocation per admitted profile, timeout120seconds; stop on failure without altered-flag retry.
scope.isolation: WSL subprocess argument arrays only, no eval/shell command string. Validate every output stays under explicit stage raw root; preserve old config and i SHA before/after. Do not run generated code.
scope.bounded_inspection: Extract only sched_core_cpu_starting section from gimple by exact declaration/function boundaries, record source dump offsets/hash and full function text. Structural inventory of branches/goto/loops/field reads/writes is tentative evidence, not normative contract, correct dataflow/alias proof or passed architecture comparison.
scope.claims: GCC success alone is not obligation extraction. GIMPLE may lower constructs or optimize; source coordinates/reads/writes and provenance need separate review. Do not count two profiles as two defects or new independent cases.

roles.n2_selector: Prepare safe once-only compiler probe and capture/finite function extraction; do not execute until root and audit approve command plan
roles.authority_audit: Review command derivation, output isolation, i/config identity and frontend claim boundaries before execution; then review evidence
roles.arch_check_review: Independent read-only postexecution compiler-output/consumer inventory review, no models/new source

new_target_compilations: at most2 to assembly/dumps, separately reported
exit: One bounded compiler feasibility loop; preserve failure, do not recursively expand helpers or fix frozen ordinary-C components.
